method: Same JPEG bytes per image, loaded once; capture and JPEG disk reads excluded from timing.
Current production extractOCR includes full JPEG decode, optional region crop, grayscale/invert, 2x PGM, Tesseract --oem 3 --psm 6 subprocess, and postprocessing.

Experimental prototype analyzeNativeVision includes JPEG metadata decode, optional full JPEG decode plus region crop and JPEG quality95 encode, system osascript startup, accurate Vision OCR, language autodetection with correction disabled, JSON parsing and pixel conversion.
Five timed repetitions per path per image, no discarded warmup, invocation order alternates by image and repetition; first invocation is included in reported median.

Raw character error rate preserves all whitespace and case; normalized character error rate uses case-sensitive Levenshtein rune distance after Unicode whitespace collapse divided by expected rune count; only computed where full expected text is supplied.
Exact label hits are literal case-sensitive substrings; normalized label hits collapse whitespace and lowercase before substring matching.
Vision coordinate hit requires a normalized text-matching observation center inside the expected top-left pixel rectangle; this measures OCR line location, not control semantics.
Fixture rectangles are broad line regions derived from generator positions (x20,y14+38*line,24px monospace); physical rectangles come from the manifest.

Region inputs use the original full screenshot JPEG with the actual production region parameter for both paths; region timing includes crop/encode work. Screenshot dimensions and Vision box coordinates remain in the full original image coordinate system.
Current Tesseract integration exposes plain text only, so coordinate metrics are unavailable; this is not a statement about the Tesseract engine's TSV/hOCR capability.

ground_truth_notes.physical_ground_truth: Transcribed before seeing OCR output. Body is intended HID text, visually checked for changes in TextEdit. Labels are selected useful text, not complete screen transcription. Menu labels omit trailing ellipsis to avoid glyph-vs-string ambiguity; disabled menu items included.
ground_truth_notes.textedit: Unsaved rich text document, Helvetica 12, default formatting
ground_truth_notes.capture: 1920x1080 AVFoundation unchanged JPEG; crop diagnostic separately recompressed quality95,no chroma subsampling

limitations: Nine images on one Mac host, five alternating calls per engine per image; no general speed or accuracy guarantee.
Four small synthetic terminal fixtures, four full-screen physical Mac captures, and one real region request on the full TextEdit capture. Small fixture timing is not full-screen tool timing.
Capture and disk reads excluded from engine timings. Region timings include full JPEG decoding, cropping, and the actual OCR pipeline.
Tesseract used the existing English single-block mode and 2x preprocessing; Vision used accurate recognition, language autodetection and no correction. Neither engine was tuned per image.

Physical label scores are literal query hits for a predefined partial transcript, not whole-screen character accuracy or exact UI identification. Coordinates require matching text and box-center overlap with a manually chosen target area.
Only synthetic fixtures and the controlled document region have a complete transcript for character error rates. Confidence is an engine score, not an accuracy guarantee.

Physical screenshots and the experimental Vision source remain in the local benchmark directory and are not committed. The reproduction script and preserved prototype are local artifacts referenced by provenance.

reports.detail: capture_screen must succeed before absolute mouse input
region requires nonnegative x and y and positive width and height
region must fit inside the 1920x1080 screenshot

physical_mcp_smoke.note: Single functional run on the connected Mac with 1920x1080 AVFoundation capture, se105 layout and audio off. Initial full-frame call includes capture startup; do not use these timings as a paired benchmark. Verified region text only, no mouse-coordinate establishment, and invalid geometry/bounds errors.
